funding.value: First-year PhD students likely supported via RA/TA ($27,048/academic year plus full-tuition scholarship and 50% mandatory fees for up to 5 years), contingent on funding availability.
funding.quote: First year PhD students are likely to have some financial support provided through Research Assistantships (RAs) or Teaching Assistantships (TAs), though support is not guaranteed. | students admitted to the PhD program may receive $27,048 per academic year through graduate assistantships, plus a full-tuition scholarship, low-cost health care insurance premiums, and payment coverage of 50% of University mandatory fees for up to 5 years in the program.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a valid BA or BS from an accredited institution.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold a valid BA or BS from an accredited institution. They should supply official transcripts from each undergraduate and graduate institution they have attended.
